#Blueface’s BM Nevaeh Says She Would Never Date A Man Who Works A Regular 9-To-5, Claiming That Lifestyle Is Below Her Standards 👀😳

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Michael Porter, is a 29-year-old rapper, entertainer, and livestreamer from Los Angeles, California. He rose to fame in 2018 with his viral hit “Thotiana,” which became a major success and helped establish him as one of the most recognizable West Coast rappers. Known for his unique offbeat flow, outspoken personality, and controversial relationships, Blueface has remained a major topic across social media. In recent years, he has expanded into livestreaming, sharing his personal life, relationships, and family moments with fans. He is also known for his relationships with Jaidyn Alexis, Chrisean Rock, and Nevaeh Akira. 

Nevaeh Akira, whose real name is Akira Williams, is a social media personality, influencer, and livestreamer who gained widespread attention through her relationship with Los Angeles rapper Blueface. The two began dating in 2025, with their relationship becoming a major topic across social media due to their public arguments, livestreams, and personal drama. In August 2026, Nevaeh welcomed a baby boy named Johnathan Jr. with Blueface. She also has an older son named Superior from a previous relationship. Following her highly publicized breakup with Blueface in September 2026, Nevaeh continued making headlines through her livestreams and outspoken personality. Most recently, she sparked conversation after reportedly saying she would never date a man working a regular 9-to-5 job because she considers that lifestyle beneath her standards.
